items.name: firefly-base
items.title: Firefly Base v1
items.description: Install this first in every site. Design tokens for Tailwind v4, the scroll-reveal system, parallax, art-scale, the button set (pill buttons, round icon buttons, switch tabs, pagination dots), the hero CTA pair, a two-tone headline helper and a content-free visual placeholder.

items.name: navigation-sticky-v1
items.title: Navigation Sticky v1
items.description: Fixed 64px header styled after the ElevenLabs bar: brand, 14px links in pills that fill grey on hover, an optional white Log in pill and the primary pill. Turns translucent with a hairline after a few pixels of scroll; on mobile a round hamburger opens a simple panel.

items.name: navigation-centered-v1
items.title: Navigation Centered v1
items.description: Fixed 64px header with the links on the left, the brand centred and the CTAs on the right. Same styling as the other navigations (14px pill links with a grey hover fill, 36px pills, round hamburger). With overHero it starts transparent over a hero photo in light text with a thin divider, and becomes the standard bar on scroll.

items.name: navigation-slide-out-v1
items.title: Navigation Slide-out v1
items.description: Fixed 64px header in the ElevenLabs style (14px links in pills with a grey hover fill, white Log in pill, primary pill) plus a round dot-grid menu button on every breakpoint. The button opens a right-side panel that slides in over a dimmed page: big primary links, the CTAs again and small link groups at the bottom.

items.name: hero-centered-v1
items.title: Hero Centered v1
items.description: Centred copy with a stacked two-tone h1, optional eyebrow and body, the dark + ghost CTA pair, and a large visual underneath. The copy reveals line by line on load; the visual follows and drifts down as it scrolls out.

items.name: hero-left-v1
items.title: Hero Left v1
items.description: Hero Centered with the copy aligned left (the ElevenLabs layout): stacked two-tone h1 and the CTA pair in the left column, the lead paragraph in the right column centred on the headline, and the same large visual underneath. Same sizes, reveal and parallax as Hero Centered.

items.name: hero-split-v1
items.title: Hero Split v1
items.description: Copy on one side, visual on the other: left-aligned two-tone h1, optional eyebrow, body and mono note, the dark + ghost CTA pair. Stacks copy-first on mobile; `reverse` puts the visual on the left.

items.name: hero-portrait-v1
items.title: Hero Portrait v1
items.description: Portrait visual on the left, copy on the right: a two-tone h1 that reveals word by word, a short body and the CTA pair. Full-width visual on mobile, side by side from tablet.

items.name: hero-news-bento-v1
items.title: Hero News Bento v1
items.description: Editorial front page: masthead with a stacked two-tone h1 and intro, then a bento of stories — one large lead card with the image behind a dark gradient and 3–5 smaller cards with kicker, title and an optional image slot.

items.name: feature-row-interactive-v1
items.title: Feature Row Interactive v1
items.description: Two-tone headline and a list of steps on one side, a 720×560 visual frame on the other. The steps are an accordion: one open at a time, and opening a step crossfades the frame to that step's visual.

items.name: icon-grid-v1
items.title: Icon Grid v1
items.description: A two-tone headline over a grid of plain items: an 80px rounded tile with a mark, a title and two lines. Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile, no card borders — six capabilities without six boxes. One tile can carry a photo or gradient background as the single point of colour.

items.name: feature-row-checks-v1
items.title: Feature Row Checks v1
items.description: Compact two-tone headline and a static list of ✓ + title + body items on one side, one 720×560 visual on the other. Every item is open; nothing collapses.

items.name: lenses-list-v1
items.title: Lenses List v1
items.description: Two-tone headline with a portrait visual under it, next to a list of large clickable names. The active name is black with a short description, the others grey; choosing one crossfades the visual.

items.name: stats-rows-v1
items.title: Stats Rows v1
items.description: Two-tone headline with an optional eyebrow, intro and ghost pill above a list of hairline-separated rows: a large value or step number on the left, a title and short description on the right. Three columns from tablet up, stacked on mobile.

items.name: steps-cards-v1
items.title: Steps Cards v1
items.description: A process in a row: two-tone heading with a short intro on the right, then one bordered card per step with an icon slot (numbered tile by default), title and body. Side by side on desktop, a 3-column grid on tablet, hairline rows on mobile.

items.name: stats-grid-v1
items.title: Stats Grid v1
items.description: Dark (or light) results section: an optional two-tone heading, an optional large quote with attribution, and a grid of 3–4 big numbers with a hairline above each. Two columns on mobile, one column per stat from tablet up.

items.name: before-after-compare-v1
items.title: Before/After Compare v1
items.description: Two-tone headline above two rounded panels: a neutral “before” panel with dash-marked pain points and a dark “after” panel with check-marked gains. Each panel has a mono label, a visual slot and an optional lead line. Side by side from tablet up, stacked on mobile.

items.name: carousel-coverflow-v1
items.title: Carousel Coverflow v1
items.description: Two-tone headline over a cover-flow of portrait cards: the centre card full size, the neighbours smaller and faded. Round prev/next buttons, pagination dots with a sliding line for the active card, click a side card, arrow keys, mouse and touch drag with snap and flick, and autoplay with a visible pause button that is off under reduced motion.

items.name: logo-marquee-v1
items.title: Logo Marquee v1
items.description: A compact strip of logos sliding sideways on a CSS transform loop, with an optional mono eyebrow and soft edge fades. One row, or two rows moving in opposite directions; pauses on hover and stands still under reduced motion.

items.name: bento-cards-v1
items.title: Bento Cards v1
items.description: Two-tone headline and a grid of equal-height cards in three tones: a photo filling the card under a gradient, a dark surface or a light surface with a visual slot in the middle. One column on mobile, two on tablet, four on desktop (three for 5–6 cards). Cards lift on hover and can be links.

items.name: testimonial-quote-v1
items.title: Testimonial Quote v1
items.description: One large centred quote with a 48px avatar, name and role, on a dark or light background. Optional mono eyebrow and company mark; eyebrow, quote and attribution fade in one after another.

items.name: faq-accordion-v1
items.title: FAQ Accordion v1
items.description: Centred two-tone headline over a 900px list of questions with soft hairlines and a turning chevron. One answer open at a time; the shared FAQ for Solve and Verb.

items.name: faq-centered-v2
items.title: FAQ Centered v2
items.description: Centred two-tone headline over a 900px list where every question sits in its own rounded stroked box; opening one grows the box and shows the answer inside. One answer open at a time.

items.name: faq-split-v1
items.title: FAQ Split v1
items.description: Two-tone headline and a ghost button on the left, accordion on the right. One question open at a time, all closed by default, with a rotating +/– glyph.

items.name: faq-split-v2
items.title: FAQ Split v2
items.description: Two-tone headline and a ghost button on the left, accordion on the right. One question open at a time, all closed by default, with a rotating +/– glyph.

items.name: faq-centered-v1
items.title: FAQ Centered v1
items.description: Two-tone headline on top, a centred accordion (640px tablet / 760px desktop) below and a contact line with a ghost pill at the bottom. One question open at a time, all closed by default, with a rotating +/– glyph.

items.name: cta-demo-pill-v1
items.title: CTA Demo Pill v1
items.description: Centred closing call to action: a small mono pill tag, a big two-tone heading, a short body, the primary + ghost button pair and a small note. Optional product visual below in a rounded frame with a 30px parallax. Dark or light.

items.name: cta-newsletter-v1
items.title: CTA Newsletter v1
items.description: Centred email sign-up: two-tone heading, one line of body and a pill form with a labelled email field and a dark submit button. The confirmation appears in a reserved status slot, so nothing shifts. Optional ticked benefits and a visual slot. Nothing is sent until a backend is connected.

items.name: popups-signup-v1
items.title: Sign-up Popup v1
items.description: Modal popup with one labelled email field and a primary button, for waitlists and demo requests. Validates inline in a reserved slot, then either crossfades to a thank-you view inside the popup (V1) or closes and hands over to the site (V2, e.g. the Thank-you Bar). Built on the Base Popup: native dialog, focus trap, Escape, overlay click, focus restore, rise-in animation.

items.name: popups-thank-you-v1
items.title: Thank-you Popup v1
items.description: Thank-you V1: the confirmation as a modal popup — a check mark in a soft circle, a short title, one line of body and a full-width Close button. Exports the panel on its own too, so the Sign-up Popup can crossfade to it in place. Focus lands on the title, so screen readers hear the confirmation.

items.name: popups-thank-you-bar-v1
items.title: Thank-you Bar v1
items.description: Thank-you V2: a white pill that slides down from the top edge of the page, over the navigation — check mark, bold title, grey body and a × button. Hides itself after 6 s (pauses while hovered or focused), announces itself as a status message, instant under reduced motion. Pair it with the Sign-up Popup: close the popup on Join and show the bar.

items.name: careers-hero-v1
items.title: Careers Hero v1
items.description: Opener of a careers page: centred stacked two-tone h1 and a wide clipped frame for a team photo. The headline reveals first, the visual 300ms later.

items.name: careers-about-v1
items.title: Careers About v1
items.description: “Who we are”: a section headline and a column of short lead-size paragraphs capped at 920px. Paragraphs stagger in after the headline.

items.name: careers-values-v1
items.title: Careers Values v1
items.description: “How we work”: a section headline and a two-column grid of short principles (title + one or two sentences). Single column on phones.

items.name: careers-roles-v1
items.title: Careers Roles v1
items.description: “Open roles”: a section headline and a hairline list of roles; each row links to the role page, with its facts (type, location) and an arrow on the right. Empty state text when there are no roles.

items.name: careers-job-v1
items.title: Careers Job v1
items.description: A role page: back link, title, fact chips, an Apply pill that scrolls to the form, shared intro paragraphs and the role's sections (paragraphs and bullet lists) in a 760px column. Pair it with Careers Apply.

items.name: careers-apply-v1
items.title: Careers Apply v1
items.description: Application form in a muted card: name, e-mail, phone, read-only role, resume drop zone (click or drag, size limit), cover letter, URL, location, notes and a full-width primary pill. Locks after a valid submit and confirms in a reserved status slot.

items.name: footer-v1
items.title: Footer v1
items.description: Footer with a top hairline, dark by default or light (tone="light"): brand and tagline, link columns and an email sign-up form with an inline confirmation. Stacked on mobile, brand and columns side by side on tablet, three columns on desktop.

items.name: footer-light-v1
items.title: Footer Light v1
items.description: The Footer on the page surface: ink text, light hairlines, the same brand + tagline, link columns, email sign-up and legal line. It is footer-v1 with tone="light" (same file).

items.name: verb-audio-queue-v1
items.title: Audio Queue v1
items.description: Verb Reader's audio queue with the player under it: five summaries, hover and click to load a row, a progress bar that runs, pause, skip and speed. Sized by its own width, so it works on a marketing page and inside the app.

items.name: verb-mini-player-v1
items.title: Mini Player v1
items.description: The floating Verb Reader mini player (Figma player v3, mobile 358 × 58): source mark, title and source, play / pause and next, a 4px progress line. Part of the Mobile Player flow and shipped in the same file.

items.name: verb-interests-picker-v1
items.title: Interests Picker v1
items.description: The Verb Reader sign-up step "Pick your interests": toggle chips with a live counter. Chips keep their size when toggled, so the card never jumps.

items.name: verb-signup-card-v1
items.title: Sign-up Card v1
items.description: The Verb Reader account card: the mark, a title, an e-mail field and a Subscribe button. A working mock: the field takes input, the button and Enter call back.

items.name: verb-feed-sidebar-v1
items.title: Feed Sidebar v1
items.description: The Verb Reader sidebar: the sidebar is the feed. Hover a row and press the bin to remove an interest or a channel; Add interest opens a field to type a new one.

items.name: verb-desktop-app-v1
items.title: Desktop App v1
items.description: The Verb Reader desktop app from Figma (For You · 1280, Desktop Player, Audio queue), working end to end at 1280 × 800: sidebar, feed in Excerpt and Compact layouts, article side panel, topic feeds, Add interest, loading / error / empty states, the floating player with queue, speed, menus and snackbars.

items.name: verb-mobile-player-v1
items.title: Mobile Player v1
items.description: The Verb Reader mobile player flow from Figma, working end to end: feed → mini player → full player with scrubber, speed list, summary, queue, menus and snackbars. All 16 designed states are reachable by clicking.
